song.title: O Lord, you're beautiful

[C1] . G D Em (D) A D I want to take your word and shine it all around . G E Asus A But first help me just, to live it Lord__ . G D Em And when I'm do-ing well . (D) A F# Help me to never seek a crown . Bm (D) G A Dsus D For my reward is giving glory to You__
[V2] . D G/D D A Oh Lord, please light the fire . D Bm Asus A That once burned bright and clean . Bm F#m G A D Replace the lamp of my first love . Em A Bm That burns with holy fear . G A D That burns with holy fear
